diagnosis.what_happened: academic-writer bundled multiple sections into a single markdown file, dumped it into the Problem Statement section, and erased the Key Terms section causing collateral destruction of Operational Definitions.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: This caused structural corruption of the DOCX, duplicate headers, and missing sections.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Markdown revisions must be parsed into discrete sections and injected strictly under their corresponding canonical DOM headings. Deletions must strictly target specific sub-headings.
diagnosis.rationale_why: OpenXML documents require structural integrity. Unscoped injection and deletion break the semantic order and destroy unrevised sibling sections.

desired_behavior: 1. Surgical DOM Section Replacement: Markdown revisions containing multiple headings must be parsed into discrete sections and injected strictly under their corresponding canonical DOM headings. 2. Precise Node Deletion: Deletion logic must strictly target specific sub-headings without performing unbounded wipes that destroy sibling sections. 3. Structural Validation Invariant: The validator MUST evaluate the DOM hierarchy, enforce canonical sequence, and assert explicit presence of non-negotiable sections.
generalization: Never use monolithic injection or unbounded deletions when manipulating OpenXML DOM. Maintain rigorous structural bounds for every section.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero destruction of unrevised sibling sections
